categories.name: Wedding Catering
categories.description:
Elegant full-service catering for ceremonies,
receptions, and unforgettable wedding celebrations.

items.title: Elegant Wedding Banquet
items.text: Thoughtfully prepared menus for ceremonies, receptions, and unforgettable celebrations. Includes Ethiopian and western fusion dishes. Service: Full setup, serving, and cleanup included.

items.title: Reception Dining
items.text: Served with style for intimate receptions and grand wedding nights. Authentic Doro Wot and habesha favorites alongside international options. Service: Full catering with elegant presentation.

items.title: Ceremony Feast
items.text: A warm menu selection designed for memorable wedding moments. Fusion of Ethiopian and international cuisine tailored to your guests. Service: Custom menu planning available.

categories.name: Corporate Events
categories.description:
Polished, reliable meal service for meetings,
team lunches, and company events.

items.title: Executive Catering
items.text: Polished meal service for meetings, team lunches, and company events. Meals delivered branded and on time. Service: Delivery only or full setup available.

items.title: Business Lunch Package
items.text: Reliable catering for productive sessions and client-facing occasions. Hot meals delivered in under 30 minutes. Service: Delivery included, setup optional.

items.title: Corporate Gala
items.text: Refined catering for launches, awards nights, and special business events. Full-service with elegant plating and professional staff. Service: Full catering with cleanup.

items.title: Seasonal Corporate Dining
items.text: Balanced, varied menus for recurring team meals and seasonal office gatherings. Ethiopian and international options. Service: Scheduled delivery plans available.

categories.name: Private Parties
categories.description:
Fresh dishes and sweet treats made for
joyful birthdays, graduations, and private gatherings.

items.title: Birthday Celebration Package
items.text: Fresh dishes and sweet treats made for joyful gatherings. Includes custom cake options. Service: Full catering with setup and cleanup.

items.title: Kids' Party Catering
items.text: Fun, flavorful food that keeps every guest happy. Kid-friendly menus with colorful presentation. Service: Delivery or full setup available.

items.title: Sweet Tables & Desserts
items.text: Crowd-pleasing bites and dessert options for birthday celebrations. Cakes, cookies, and custom treats. Service: Delivery or event setup.

items.title: Celebration Desserts
items.text: Colorful cakes and treats to finish the party on a high note. Includes anniversaries, graduations, baby showers, and bridal showers. Service: Custom orders welcome.

categories.name: Holiday Celebrations
categories.description:
Wholesome, flavorful menus for Christmas, Genna,
New Year's, Epiphany, and all festive occasions.

items.title: Fasting Meal Package
items.text: Wholesome plant-based dishes prepared for seasonal fasting. Rich in flavor with traditional Ethiopian ingredients. Service: Delivery or full catering setup.

items.title: Seasonal Holiday Catering
items.text: Balanced fasting-friendly and festive meals for Christmas, Genna, New Year's, Epiphany, and more. Service: Full catering with traditional dining setup available.

categories.name: Cocktail Services
categories.description:
Sophisticated catering for cocktail parties,
launches, and upscale social gatherings.

items.title: Rooftop Cocktail Package
items.text: Elegant finger foods, canapés, and beverages for cocktail parties and product launches. Professional staff and refined presentation. Service: Full catering with staff included.

items.title: Fusion Cocktail Menu
items.text: A curated mix of Ethiopian bites and international appetizers for upscale social events. Custom menu planning available. Service: Setup, serving, and cleanup included.
